spans.s:
कोश (शः) 1.
m. An egg; jewellery; an
ordeal.
f. A shoe; beard of corn.

कोष (षः-षं) 1.
m. n. A bud; a sheath;
a treasury; a dictionary; an
ordeal; a testicle. (
In compo.)
a ball.
f. Shoe; a beard of corn.

कोश-कार (रः) 1.
m. The sugar-cane.

कोष-कार (रः) 1.
m. A sugar-cane;
silk-worm; a chrysalis^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar, jim funderburk on 20210816. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/73.

कोश-फल (लं) 1.
n. A fragrant berry.

कोष-फल (लं) 1.
n. A berry having
a fragrant pulp.
m. A creeper.

कोशल (लः-ला) 1.
m. 3.
f. A name
of
Oude and of a prince.

कोषला (ला) 1.
f. The country to
the south of
Oude.

कोशला-त्म-जा (जा) 1.
f. Wife of
Da-
sharatha, and mother of
Rāma.

कोशलिक (कं) 1.
n. A bribe.

कोश-वासिन् (सी-सिनी-सि)
a. Sheath-
ed, in a shell.
m. A shell ani-
mal; a chrysalis; a silk-worm.

कोश-स्थ (स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
a. Idem.

कोशा_ङ्ग (ङ्गः) 1.
m. Reed or grass.

कोशातक (कः) 1.
m. Hair. (की)
f.
Kinds of cucurbitaceous plants.

कोषा_तक (कः) 1.
m. Hair.
f. Spe-
cies of cucumber or creeper.

कोशातकिन् (की) 5.
m. Trade; a tra-
der; submarine fire.

कोषक (कः) 1.
m. An egg.

कोष-ग्रहण (णं) 1.
n. Undergoing an
ordeal by fire, &c.

कोष-चञ्चु (ञ्चुः) 1.
m. The Indian crane.

कोष-नायक (कः) 1.
m. Indian Plu-
tus; a treasurer.

कोष-भूत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Treasured up.

कोष-वत् (वान्-वती-वत्)
a. Wealthy.

कोष-वृद्धि (द्धिः) 2.
f. Hernia.

कोष-शायिका (का) 1.
f. A knife.

कोष-शुद्धि (द्धिः) 2.
f. Justification
by passing through an ordeal.

कोष-हीन (नः-ना-नं)
a. Indigent.

कोषांश(शः) 1.
m. Part of a treasure.

कोषा_ध्यक्ष (क्षः) 1.
m. A treasurer.

कोषा_पहरण (णं) 1.
n. Robbery of a
treasury; carrying off treasure.

कोषिन् (षी) 5.
m. The mango tree.

कोष्ठ (ष्ठं) 1.
m. A granary.

कोष्ठक (कं) 1.
n. A granary; a trea-
sury; a brick trough.

कोष्ठा-गार (रः) 1.
m. A store-room.

कोष्ठा-ग्नि (ग्निः) 2.
m. Digestive power.

कोष्ण (ष्णं) 1.
n. Warmth.
a. Warm.
